text: Meet Cortex. It lives in your Mac's notch. Click it, and ask anything.
All day, Cortex reads the text on your screen, and keeps it in a private memory, right on your Mac.
So it answers from what you actually saw, and shows you exactly where it came from.
It also catches what you'd miss. When someone asks you for something, Cortex flags it as a to-do.
And it's a shared task manager for your agents. Codex starts the work, then Claude picks it up, with the full handoff.
Cortex. Local-first and open source. Get it at cortex dot vashipa dot link.
